tool.name: LRP
tool.description: Performs Layer-wise Relevance Propagation on a trained autoencoder encoder.

param.name: input_model_pth_path
param.help: Path to the trained model file whose encoder is analyzed

param.name: input_dataset_pt_path
param.help: Path to the input dataset file (.pt) used for computing relevance scores

param.name: outname_output_results_npz_path
param.help: Path to the output results file containing relevance scores (compressed NumPy archive)

param.name: config_json
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
